description: Task 2C matrix row 3 — Billing has already released the current (N) manifest hash while the deployed RAG image is still at the previous (N-1) release; N-1's own accepted set (its current-then-previous window) does not include N, so the candidate hash is absent from RAG's accepted set. row_3_clarification: Plan Revision 3, PR 2C row-3 footnote: this failure is scoped to record TOOLS (dispatch/rehydration) only.
